bullets.text: An SUV fell into a 10-foot sinkhole on Old Mahabalipuram Road near Tidel Park in Chennai after a road collapse near the metro site, leaving occupants unhurt; the office should monitor repair and traffic management.

Chennai police detained over 30 people in Besant Nagar and AISF-AIYF cadres on Anna Salai who were protesting in solidarity with CJP against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar; the office should watch law and order.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to inaugurate the Chennai Metro Phase 2 Poonamallee-Vadapalani line; the office should oversee event coordination and security arrangements.
Minister Kumar stated that management works are complete to face the northeast monsoon in Ponneri; the office should review preparedness across local bodies.
Minister Kumar inaugurated 24 garbage collection battery vehicles worth Rs. 48 lakhs for 21 panchayats at Gummidipoondi block development office; the office should track sanitation improvements.
Minister Kumar made a request to Chief Minister Vijay during the Chennai Metro Phase 2 inauguration event; the office should follow up on the specific demands raised.
Youth were arrested in Besant Nagar, Chennai, while demanding the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar and protesting Special Intensive Revision voter list changes; the office should monitor local fallout.

Contract workers staged a dharna with their families at the Kattupalli desalination plant in Ponneri demanding compensation after a worker suffered a broken leg; the office should intervene for a settlement.
Motorists faced health hazards due to garbage burning along the Ponneri-Minjur state highway due to a lack of solid waste management infrastructure; the office should expedite waste facility setup.

Water resources personnel intensified desilting work in the Nandhi River by removing weeds and grass to prevent flood risks ahead of the northeast monsoon in Tiruttani; the office should inspect progress.

Reliance Jio is set to build a 37-megawatt AI Data Centre and technology campus with a massive investment in Siruseri, Chennai, creating job opportunities; the office should facilitate project approvals.

Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that the government will release a draft consultation paper on AI regulations within 30 days and expand GPU capacity; the office should review national policy impacts.
The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology selected CoRover.ai to build a unified agentic AI platform for the government; the office should track adoption milestones.
Farmers threatened to resume an indefinite hunger strike from October 22 if crop loan waiver demands are not met within the deadline given by TVK ministers; the office should coordinate negotiations.
MK Stalin criticized the TVK government for acting as an extension of the BJP and unleashing police crackdowns on protesting students and youth; the office should prepare political responses.

Udhayanidhi Stalin condemned the TVK government for arresting peaceful youth protesters in Besant Nagar who opposed Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar; the office should monitor opposition narratives.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Chennai on a one-day visit to launch Rs. 13,000 crore worth of development projects; the office should manage event logistics.
Prime Minister Modi and Chief Minister Vijay are scheduled to jointly travel on the newly inaugurated Poonamallee-Vadapalani metro train; the office should coordinate high-security transit protocols.

A three-tier security arrangement and rehearsal drills have been deployed in Porur and across Chennai for the Prime Minister's visit and metro launch event; the office should ensure seamless execution.
